detail.longDescription:
fflate (npm) is my new best friend /lh :akko_excited:

I definitely didn't just implement the epub3 spec in a userscript that runs entirely in-browser to download fanfiction.net + fictionpress.com fics automatically, toc generation and all... :P :fernblush:

zip/deflate compress + multi-file support (even directory trees!) all in the browser! so cool~ ✨

why? fichub.net is cool, but doesn't allow for setting the series tag on the fic (which you can't infer from the web page on ffn/fp like you can ao3)

@FirefoxOfficial@mastodon.social's web dev tools were very handy, esp the multi-line editor which I've never used before!

If there's demand I'll publish the (badly implemented) script.

When ao3 comes back up and if their epub export is slow, I might port it to there also 🪿

🌠

#npm #javascript #WebBrowsing #webdev #devtools
